en: The image shows an old postcard with printed and handwritten text, a postage stamp, and a postmark. The languages on the postcard are Estonian and German. The main printed text advertises the authorized representative of the watch factories 'Zenith' and 'Gebr. Junghans' in Estonia, specifically naming F.a H. Markowitsch, with an address in Tallinn (EESTI). A green Estonian postage stamp is visible, and the postcard is addressed to Haapsalu. The postmark reads 'TALLINN EESTI' and is dated 19.X.1931.
